reads.what: A maker slice can be lost to the 200-fill window
reads.rule: backlog 202
reads.action: reproduce, then widen the window or compare share counts
reads.note: 2026-09-27: READ PERFORMED - NOT REPRODUCIBLE, and the reason it was not reproducible was itself a defect, now fixed (section 171). Zero 'fill window too short' lines exist in the whole 54 MB log and the string is present at autoTrader.ts:3607, so either the window was wide enough or the guard was blind. Both. The branch order tested 'filledTotal <= 0.005 -> autoexpired' BEFORE 'filledTotal < promoted -> warn', so the case the audit actually described - the window missing the order entirely, filledTotal 0 against a promoted slice - was reported as an ordinary unfilled expiry and logged nothing; only a PARTIAL miss could ever warn. Fixed with one exported pure classifier, pendingFillOutcome(filledTotal, promoted) -> promote|window-short|expired|none, window-short tested first; one input changes verdict and the fourth value keeps a fully-promoted order from emitting a spurious autoexpired. Six-case assertion in review-fixes. THE WINDOW WAS NOT WIDENED, on measurement: the newest 200 fills span at least 26 h over the last seven days (median 58 h, whole-month minimum 5.75 h) against a p99 filled-order lifetime of 6.8 h (max 23.8 h), and 0 of 3,374 filled orders are part-filled with size remaining; the account averages about 127 fills a day (3,814 over 30 days), not the 356-687 the old comment assumed. New trigger (the old one could not fire): the first 'fill window too short' warning, which is now reachable, OR a maintenance run measuring the newest-200-fills span below 12 h - then widen the fetch. Due is a weekly re-measure of that span, not a pending read.

reads.note: 2026-09-29, performed in three parts (section 173). (a) THE MERGE: SUPERSEDED, not built. 241 was written 2026-09-22 while momentum, log-momentum and breakout were still running; all three were read at their own registered date on 2026-09-24 (backlog 190) and STOPPED on their own evidence - -8.57c [-11.04, -6.10] over 8 day-clusters, -9.34c [-12.97, -5.72] over 7, -9.82c [-12.41, -7.23] over 7. (b) THE SIGMA: BUILT. ibkrWeather.ts charged the day-out 3F of forecast error at every hour; it now uses weatherForecast.forecastSigma(ext.hours), the same 3.0 -> 0.9 curve the Kalshi weather model has used since round 30. Sigma is the FORECAST error only - ForecastEx settles on Weather Underground and that basis is exactly what this arm exists to measure, so it is not padded in by guesswork. Tests in scripts/tests/ibkr-lab.test.ts: the same mu, strike and observations price at 0.38 a day out and materially lower late in the day, and the old flat 3F priced both the same.
